name: product-flow
description: One command for each phase of the backlog work: an idea, a request, or a bug to approved items. Each user story and bug gets acceptance criteria and a Gherkin Behaviour spec, a refine pass with the product owner, and a push to Jira, Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or files after approval. Research, a story map, and a prototype only for larger work. For product owners and business analysts.
